prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1063; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision. Presenting complaints included neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches originating at the base of the skull. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with tenderness over the paraspinal muscles and mild muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms or focal deficits identified.

The patient was diagnosed with cervical strain and was managed with a combination of manual therapy, targeted soft tissue work, therapeutic exercise for deep neck flexor and scapular stabilization, and instruction in posture and activity modification. Over the course of 13 visits, the patient demonstrated gradual improvement in pain levels, range of motion, and functional tolerance for daily activities and work duties.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported substantial but incomplete resolution of symptoms, with occasional stiffness after prolonged positioning. A home exercise program has been established. Continued self-management and periodic reassessment are recommended, with referral back for care should symptoms worsen or new neurological signs appear.
